name: This Must Be The Place

faq.answer: The note does not name its author. The writer says only that they have taken their work underground to keep it from the wrong hands, leaving the campsite and equipment behind.
The note does not reveal what work the author is taking underground. The writer says they want to keep it safe from unspecified adversaries.
faq.q: What work is being taken underground?

faq.answer: The occupant left moments before anyone arrived, and their destination is unknown. The note hints they may have gone to another hidden shelter.
faq.q: Where did the campsite's occupant go?

faq.answer: The traveler left an inadequately secured sleeping bag that unrolls on the ground, heavy canvas bundled over assorted gear, and a discarded pack containing miscellaneous gear.
faq.q: What was left behind at the campsite?

faq.answer: The note could be a farewell or a clue to the author's next underground shelter. It does not settle which.
faq.q: Is this a clue leading to another hideout?

faq.answer: The note does not identify the wrong hands. The author feared pursuit or theft and left before their work could be compromised.
faq.q: Who are the 'wrong hands' mentioned in the note?

sections.body: Someone broke camp at this secluded spot only moments ago. An inadequately secured sleeping bag unrolls underfoot, while heavy canvas lies bundled over assorted gear. A small scrap of paper holds a hurried parting message, but whoever camped here has vanished before anyone could catch up.
sections.title: A Hasty Departure

sections.body: The torn note says its author has taken their work underground to keep it from the wrong hands. Whether these are final words or a clue to the researcher's next hidden shelter remains unknown. The equipment lies abandoned for whoever found the campsite.
sections.title: Into the Underground

summary: At This Must Be The Place, a camper has vanished moments before anyone could catch up. A torn note says the writer has taken their work underground to keep it from the wrong hands.
attribution: In-game quest text: This Must Be The Place
